## Raid registered: `{team}`

From now on, **every member** of the team can comment **`/check`** here (members are read from `TEAM.md` in your repo). Flags in this issue are **team flags**: each one is computed from your team repository.

How a real team works, in five stages: a protected `main`, everyone ships through a reviewed pull request, a real review, a conflict between two PRs, and a release.
